bagPolicy.summary: Bags up to 12” x 6” x 12” are allowed, but backpacks and multi-compartment bags are prohibited. All bags will be searched, and non-clear bags may undergo additional searches.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: Premier Parking is available as an amenity on a show-by-show basis. It's recommended to check availability and consider arriving early to secure parking.

rideshare.note: Rideshare is encouraged. Drivers can drop you off outside the venue at 152 Luckie St. NW.

concessions.note: The Tabernacle does not allow outside food or drink, and there is no specific information available about food and drink options inside the venue. Drinking fountains are available for water.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Buy accessible and companion tickets online only at livenation.com, using the Filters icon to find the Accessible Seating Area; they are reserved for fans with disabilities and their companions. Seating is limited, so if it's sold out, email tabernacle@livenation.com. Balcony seating is stairs only; the main floor and lower level, including the Merch area/Cotton Club, are accessible.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Re-entry is not permitted once you exit the venue.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Pick up Will Call at the box office, on the corner of the building closest to Centennial Olympic Park on Luckie Street. It opens one hour before doors on show days only. Bring photo ID, your confirmation number, and the card used to buy; the ID name must match the order.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: If you need an accessible entrance, go to the main entrance at 152 Luckie St. NW, where a team member will help you.
